title: Benchmark Scenario
description: Schema for network-automation agent benchmark scenarios

setup.description: Operator-applied configuration that creates the fault or baseline state

prompt.description: Task description given to the agent

args_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the serialized args

required.description: Opt into strict args enforcement (outcome_lenient mode only)

forbidden_calls.description: Tool calls that immediately fail the scenario

scoring.description: Scoring algorithm: outcome_lenient (default, presence-only, read args advisory) or all_expected_present_and_ordered_no_forbidden (strict, ordered, all args enforced)
